fact: 1906年德国因殖民战争拨款问题爆发宪政危机：8月2日政府向帝国议会要求追加2,900万马克殖民拨款（西南非洲战争），社民党与中央党反对；12月13日帝国议会以177票对168票的微弱多数否决拨款，首相 Bülow 当日获皇帝同意解散帝国议会；1907年1月25日举行被称作“霍屯督人选举”（Hottentottenwahl/Hottentot election）的新选举：社民党获325.9万票（28.94%，第一大党）但因有利于农村的选区划分仅得43席（上届81席），中央党101席，Bülow 阵线（保守党+国家自由党+左自由派）获397席中的220席多数。殖民地问题由此主导了德国1906年末至1907年初的政治走向。

sources.title: Wikipedia — 1907 German federal election（Campaign 节；引 Nohlen & Stöver, Elections in Europe; Epstein, Erzberger and the German Colonial Scandals）
sources.quote: The sustained and increasingly expensive colonial war led to a political crisis in Germany on 2 August 1906, when the government requested an appropriation of 29 million marks from the Reichstag. ... On the 13th of December, the vote in the Reichstag came down with a narrow majority of 177 to 168 against the appropriation. On the same day, Chancellor Bernhard von Bulow ordered the Reichstag dissolved with the agreement of Emperor Wilhelm II. ... Federal elections were held in Germany on 25 January 1907. ... This election was known as the "Hottentot election" due to the scandal over the ongoing Herero and Nama genocide perpetrated by colonial authorities in German South West Africa. ... the SPD ... Popular vote 3,259,029 / 28.94% ... Seats won 43 (from 81) ... the bloc achieved a majority of 220 out of 397 seats.

fact: 1906年德国帝国银行（Reichsbank）因黄金外流收紧货币：1906年秋美国信贷需求迫使部分黄金经汇兑操作流向欧洲，帝国银行为维持法定三分之一黄金覆盖（Dritteldeckung）于1906年末将贴现率（Diskontsatz）提高到6%，并在此后1906/07跨年期间维持6%（跨年短期一度至7%），直到1907年4月才略降至5.5%——高贴现率贯穿整个1906年末，推高了德国企业的信贷成本，成为1907年衰退的先声。

fact: 针对英国“无畏”号，德国海军的无畏舰设计在1906年1月定型：纳绍级（Nassau-class）设计最初为8门28厘米炮方案（1905年3月批准），吸取日俄战争教训并因英国已开工全重炮战列舰，至1906年1月修改为更大的12门28厘米（11英寸）炮、六炮塔六角布局方案；首舰“纳绍”号1907年7月22日在威廉港帝国船厂龙骨铺放（约比“无畏”号晚25个月），1908年3月7日下水、1909年10月1日服役，正常排水量18,873吨、航速20节、克虏伯渗碳装甲。值得注意的是德国当时因帕森斯蒸汽轮机垄断（每台发动机100万金马克专利费、德国企业至1910年前无力规模生产）而保留三胀往复式主机——与英国无畏号的轮机路线形成对照。

sources.title: Wikipedia — SMS Nassau（Design 节；引 Dodson, The Kaiser's Battlefleet; Nottelmann & Sullivan; Staff, German Battleships Vol.1; Herwig, Luxury Fleet）
sources.quote: German designers initially considered ships equipped with 21cm (8.3 in) secondary guns ... prompted them to consider an even more powerful ship armed with an all-big-gun armament consisting of eight 28cm (11 in) guns. This initial version was approved in March 1905, but further developments were incorporated over the course of the year, in part due to lessons learned during the on-going Russo-Japanese War. By January 1906, the design was refined into a larger vessel with twelve of the guns, by which time Britain had begun work on the all-big-gun battleship HMS Dreadnought. ... Nassau was laid down on 22 July 1907 at the Kaiserliche Werft in Wilhelmshaven ... launched less than a year later on 7 March 1908, approximately 25 months after Dreadnought. ... At the time, Parsons held a monopoly on steam turbines and required a 1 million gold mark royalty fee for every turbine engine made. German firms were not ready to begin production of turbines on a large scale until 1910.

fact: 1906年的普鲁士仍实行三级选举权（Preussisches Dreiklassenwahlrecht）：其法律基础为1849年5月30日选举条例及1850年1月31日普鲁士宪法第71条，直至1918年革命才废止。年满25岁、在普鲁士市镇居住满6个月、未因判决丧失公民权且未领取贫民救济的男性有选举权；选民按直接税（分类所得税、财产税、营业税及1891年后的地方直接税）缴税额分为三级，各级税额合计各占三分之一，分别选出同等数量的选举人再间接选出邦议会（Landtag）与市议会代表；投票公开不保密。全国约80%—85%的选民落在第三等级，第一等级仅约4%。1906年该制度仅经历程序性小改：5万人口以上城市以限时投票取代选举集会；1906年选区重划法（大柏林+5席、鲁尔+4席、上西里西亚+1席）自1908年选举起生效。

sources.title: Wikipedia — Prussian three-class franchise（Legal basis / Eligibility / The three classes /1906 amendments 节；统计数据引 Ritter, Wahlgeschichtliches Arbeitsbuch, Munich 1980）
sources.quote: The Prussian three-class franchise (German: Preussisches Dreiklassenwahlrecht) was an indirect electoral system used from 1848 until 1918 ... Voters were grouped by district into three classes, with the total tax payments in each class equal. ... Voting was not secret. ... Every Prussian male who had reached the age of 25 and had lived in a Prussian municipality for at least six months was eligible to vote. He could not have lost his civil rights through a legal judgment or be receiving public assistance for the poor. ... In 1906, in cities with a population of 50,000 or more, the electoral assembly was replaced by the time-limit voting ... a law of 1906 that was effective with the 1908 election ... a total of 10 additional seats ... (Greater Berlin 5, Ruhr 4, and Upper Silesia 1). ... Nationwide, the third class accounted for about 80 to 85 percent of eligible voters, and the first class for about 4%.

fact: 1906年秋鲁尔煤矿区矿工工资成为劳资斗争焦点并首次按月统计公布：此前普鲁士各矿业区（Oberbergämter）仅按季度调查矿工工资并在帝国公报（Reichsanzeiger）公布；1906年因以工资问题为起点的矿工运动持续，多特蒙德王家高等矿业局（Königliches Oberbergamt zu Dortmund）改为按月统计鲁尔区1906年10月与11月的矿工工资，相关报道以《科隆晚报》晚版第69号（Die Löhne der Ruhrbergarbeiter in den Monaten Oktober und November 1906）刊出，并被《德意志帝国社会政策史料集》（第IV部门第3卷第1册，1994年版）第7号文献收录——显示1906年鲁尔矿工工资水平处于高频博弈与官方密切监测状态。
